# registry-auth-proxy

> A stateless, dependency-free Go reverse proxy that lets joxit/docker-registry-ui
> browse a token-authenticated CNCF Distribution registry without a login dialog. It
> holds one read-only machine identity (registry-browser) and performs the Bearer token
> dance transparently for every request. Runs on `scratch` as non-root UID 65534.

## Purpose

- Front joxit for a Distribution registry that requires Bearer token auth.
- Remove joxit's credential prompt by owning authentication: predict scope, fetch/cache
  tokens from the registry token service, inject Bearer headers, retry on challenge.
- Never let the UI see a 401 (which would trigger its login dialog).

## Endpoints

- `GET /healthz` — returns `200 {"status":"ok"}`.
- `*` (any other path) — reverse-proxied to `UPSTREAM_URL` with transparent Bearer auth.
- CLI: `-healthcheck` dials `/healthz` and exits 0/1 (container HEALTHCHECK).

## Configuration (environment variables)

- `PORT` (default 8181)
- `UPSTREAM_URL` (required) — Distribution registry base URL
- `TOKEN_ENDPOINT` (required) — token service GET /token URL (internal)
- `CLIENT_ID` (default registry-browser) — Hydra client_id for Basic auth
- `CLIENT_SECRET_FILE` (required) — file with the client secret; never an inline env var
- `TOKEN_REFRESH_MARGIN` (default 30s) — evict cached tokens this early before expiry
- `LOG_LEVEL` (default info)

## Request flow

- Predict OCI scope from URL path (catalog / repository:*:pull).
- Cache hit → forward with cached token. Miss → probe unauthenticated.
- Non-401 → stream back. 401 → parse challenge, fetch token, cache, retry with Bearer.
- Still 401 with a token attached → remap to 403 (no login dialog).

## Security invariants

- Client secret file-only, never logged; Bearer tokens never logged.
- Fail closed: token-fetch error → 502, never a naked 401.
- Inbound Authorization headers stripped; hop-by-hop headers stripped both directions.
- Read-only identity: only pull/catalog scopes predicted or requested.
- Response bodies streamed, never fully buffered.

## Supply chain

- Multi-arch images (amd64/arm64) on quay.io + Docker Hub.
- SBOM (SPDX) + SLSA provenance attached; keyless cosign signatures over the digest.
- Base image pinned by digest; reproducible build; standard library only (no deps).
